name: VIDEO POKER
description: Video Poker is a casino card game played on machines (or digitally). Based on Five-Card Draw poker. Player gets 5 cards, chooses which to hold/discard, draws replacements. Payout based on final hand strength. Jacks or Better is most common variant. Perfect strategy yields near 99.5% return.

content.text: Video Poker is a casino card game played on machines (or digitally). Based on Five-Card Draw poker. Player gets 5 cards, chooses which to hold/discard, draws replacements. Payout based on final hand strength. Jacks or Better is most common variant. Perfect strategy yields near 99.5% return.

Video poker first became commercially viable in the mid-1970s when it became economical to combine a television-like monitor with a solid-state CPU; the earliest models appeared alongside the first personal computers. SIRCOMA (Si Redd's Coin Machines, later International Game Technology) introduced Draw Poker in 1979. Throughout the 1980s video poker became increasingly popular in US casinos as players found the machines less intimidating than table games. The game has its roots in five-card draw but is played against a machine with a fixed paytable rather than against other hands.
